commercialPurpose: Close an editorial/lifestyle page with visual proof, brand recall, and light navigation rather than a heavy generic footer slab.
purposeLayer: The footer reinforces the publication mood through a browsable image ribbon before quiet legal/social closure.
anatomyLayer: Full-width image strip, centered brand/logo mark, short description or copyright, social icons, and small utility links.
hierarchyLayer: Image ribbon first, brand mark second, social/legal microcopy third.
gridRhythmLayer: Horizontal thumbnail rail spanning the page above a centered low-density footer body.
densityLimitLayer: Use 5-10 thumbnails, 1 brand mark, 1 short copy line, 3-6 social links, and 2-5 utility links.
originalityLayer: Learn visual-proof closure; adapt it as gallery strip, customer proof strip, product strip, venue strip, or portfolio strip.
usageRuleLayer: Use for visual/editorial/lifestyle products where closing with imagery improves memory and browsing.
layoutGesture: visual ribbon leading into quiet brand footer
sectionSilhouette: full-width thumbnail band over centered compact footer
compositionTension: dense image strip resolves into sparse brand closure
focalPath: thumbnail strip to brand mark to social/legal row
negativeSpaceShape: wide footer floor under a tight visual rail
depthLayering: flat image rail with calm footer surface beneath
moduleScaleVariation: many small images against one large brand mark
breakoutBehavior: image rail can go full bleed while footer content stays contained
antiCopyBoundary: Do not copy exact Instagram imagery, signature logo, low-contrast footer text, or muted gold accent system.

hyperAccuracyReceipt.reviewNotes: Checkpoint learning is visually inspected but not yet promoted to stable PASS; keep as incoming review vocabulary.
hyperAccuracyReceipt.nonCopyBoundary: Do not copy the Pallas-style script logo, muted gold CTA treatment, right-sidebar widget order, image set, or exact editorial spacing.
